body:
Cuts 1.13.0, the first release built by [[T-142]]'s release.sh rather than by
hand.

Carries, since v1.12.0:
- T-137 registry sorted by name (android)
- T-138 store suggestions (android)
- T-139 store suggestions (web), plus T-145 and T-146 found alongside
- T-140 picking a name suggestion adds the item straight away (both clients)
- T-141 python lint/format gate
- T-142 release.sh + smoke-wheel.sh
- T-135 docs for the app-version endpoint

Minor, not patch: new user-facing behaviour, no breaking change to the wire
contract, the HTTP API, or the blueprint mount interface.

It is also the first release the 1.12.0 in-app update check can actually notice,
so the update prompt gets its first real-world exercise here.
title: Release 1.13.0
